en.description:
Defend the shore from your Apple Watch.

Call Of Defence is a free, offline coastal defence game built for watchOS 26 or later. Turn your wrist to aim, turn the Digital Crown to zoom, and hold the fire button to engage approaching threats.

Learn the controls in the first-launch tutorial or replay it from Briefing. Tap the viewfinder to recenter your aim. Manage cannon heat with short bursts, pause whenever you need a break, and use touch dragging when wrist input is unavailable.

Survive three 20-second waves, then continue into Endless with your score, health and battlefield intact. Ordinary and Endless best scores, sound, haptics, layout preferences and tutorial status stay on your Watch.

No account, companion iPhone app, internet connection, ads, analytics, tracking, subscriptions or in-app purchases are required.
en.subtitle: Coastal Combat on Your Wrist
